parent: Exact frozen f696 A_0 allocation and b472 action/risk/recovery; 0bp Tiered own-state Stage1 for attribution, SOXX final benchmark
failure_mechanism: The exact f696 account loses in 564/819 overlapping 126-day windows, while each prior SOXX 5/20 trend-sign state contains both winning and losing windows. A completed prior-session overnight gap followed by regular-session recovery is a possible within-trend discriminator of rebound versus persistent selling. It is not a window switch.
distinctness: Original39 has price momentum, volatility, panic_reversal_5 and trend features but no one-session SOXX close-to-open minus open-to-close decomposition. The closed opening_state/interaction used same-trade-day opening data after f696 09:29; day_night_supervision altered auxiliary targets rather than adding this prior-day input; signed_variance_information targeted next-day RV.

fixed_feature.name: SOXX_prior_session_intraday_minus_overnight_log_return
fixed_feature.formula: log(SOXX close_t/open_t) - log(open_t/close_{t-1}) on completed signal day t, using Qlib split-continuous daily open and close

if_pass: Freeze a separate original39 versus original39-plus-one H5 cash-advantage information test with expected negative added coefficient, exact common maturity/calendar, full/both-halves/complete-year and corrected block gates. Only a passing test can justify a full f696-derived own-state 0bp Tiered account.
stop: Any source hash, Qlib calendar, positive price, decision clock or novelty failure closes this fixed feature before fit; do not tune sign, lag, window, threshold or endpoint years.
